periods.time: About one hour after Stella's rescue and after a short rest by Itsuki

name.zh: 月影与严决定终结解放军旧体制
name.en: Tsukikage and Itsuki Decide to End the Rebellion System

periods.location: Hospital in Kansai where Prime Minister Tsukikage recovers
periods.summary: After Tsukikage awakens from his nightmare of Tokyo burning, he and Itsuki agree their generation must expose and end the hidden system that used Rebellion as a necessary evil.
periods.cause: The crises caused by Or-Gaule and Eilands reveal that maintaining Rebellion as a controlled third pole after the war produced new monsters and endangered the next generation.
periods.process: Itsuki briefs Tsukikage on Union policy: avoid forcing the League too hard, accept the League doves' claim that Eilands and a faction caused the war, and use Fu Xiaoli's defeat of Eilands as a compromise point. Tsukikage admits his fear of a future Tokyo inferno led him to schemes that underestimated younger knights. Itsuki states that preserving an old order by tolerating evil has failed and that their generation must take blame rather than pass it on.
periods.outcome: Tsukikage agrees to help persuade Union governments and clean up the old arrangement. The Union/League world structure is expected to undergo major changes beyond Ikki's immediate story.
periods.significance: Closes the political arc of the Rebellion-era three-power balance and frames the older generation taking responsibility so the young heroes inherit a cleaner future.
